The '''T8 loading vehicle''' was a type of vehicle that could be used for loading cargo on and off [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. It was cheap, easy to use; and had an open cab with front-loading forks. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], one was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at [[Akkalo Station]], a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] that was located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]].
